user.title: Pair with Danfoss Icon
user.description: In the Danfoss Icon app on Android, open Settings > Share house and enter the one-time code here (dashes are fine). Keep the app open on that screen until pairing finishes. Home Assistant joins your house as another user, and every room on the master controller is added.

reconfigure.title: Pair again
reconfigure.description: Generate a new one-time code in the Danfoss Icon app (Settings > Share house) to pair Home Assistant with the same house again.

error.invalid_otp: The code was rejected or has expired. Generate a new one in the app and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Danfoss cloud relay.
error.not_icon: The shared house has no Danfoss Icon master controller.

abort.wrong_house: That code belongs to a different house.
